tools.name: about_raise_lens
tools.title: About Raise Lens
tools.description: Call this first. Returns what Raise Lens covers (sustainability grants, tenders, programmes and funders), which tools return summaries and which return full records, the daily result limits, and the links to raiselens.com to get started.

caller.description: Who is calling: anonymous, or the level of access of the connected user.

tools.name: search_opportunities
tools.title: Search funding opportunities
tools.description: Search Raise Lens for sustainability funding opportunities (grants and tenders) by topic, sector, country and deadline. Returns up to 10 matches, each with title, summary, sectors, geography, deadline, amount and a link to the opportunity page on raiselens.com. New listings enter these results at once with full access; otherwise tenders and subcontracts 7 days and grants 30 days after Raise Lens lists them, or 7 days before they close if sooner. Public notices are named in full at once; other listings 14 days after Raise Lens lists them, or at once with full access.

query.description: Search terms: what the project needs funding for.

sectors.description: Raise Lens sector slugs, such as renewable-energy. Only the first is used as a filter; put the rest in `query`.

geography.description: Country or region: ISO-2 ("DE"), English name ("Germany"), or an aggregate ("EU", "Global South").

deadline_before.description: Only opportunities closing on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

amount_display.description: Funding amount as published, or null when none is given.

access.description: Level of detail in this record.

cta.description: Link to the Raise Lens page that lists what each option includes.

note.description: Match count and what the records include.

tools.name: count_matching_opportunities
tools.title: Count matching funding opportunities
tools.description: Count the open Raise Lens grants and tenders that match a search by topic, sector, country and deadline. Returns only the number and a link to the same search on raiselens.com; no records. New listings enter these results at once with full access; otherwise tenders and subcontracts 7 days and grants 30 days after Raise Lens lists them, or 7 days before they close if sooner.

query.description: Search terms: what the project needs funding for.

sectors.description: Raise Lens sector slugs, such as renewable-energy. Only the first is used as a filter; put the rest in `query`.

geography.description: Country or region: ISO-2 ("DE"), English name ("Germany"), or an aggregate ("EU", "Global South").

deadline_before.description: Only opportunities closing on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

tools.name: match_organisation
tools.title: Match an organisation to funding
tools.description: Match an organisation to open Raise Lens grants and tenders, from its website address or from a short profile (sectors, country, organisation type, stage). With a website address, Raise Lens reads the public homepage and up to three of its pages (robots.txt obeyed) and extracts the profile; a profile skips the reading. Returns the profile used, the number of strong matches and the best matches ranked by relevance, each with a one-line reason and its raiselens.com page. Website reading has a daily limit per caller; a profile has none.

url.description: The organisation's website (example.org), its name without the domain ending, or its LinkedIn company page.

profile.description: Use instead of url when the organisation is already known.

sectors.description: Raise Lens sector slugs or plain words ("solar", "water"); up to 4.

country.description: Where it works: ISO-2 ("KE"), English name ("Kenya") or "global".

check_size_band.description: Funding size band, as the Raise Lens matching questions use it (xs, small, medium-small, medium, medium-large, large, xl, mega).

activities.description: Up to 6 short phrases for what it does ("mangrove restoration").

summary.description: One or two sentences on what it does.

status.description: ok, or why there are no matches (rate_limited, cap_reached, unreadable, ...).

summary.description: What the organisation does, as read from its website.

profile.description: The profile the matches are ranked against.

exact.description: false when the count is a lower bound.

reason.description: Why it matches, in one line.

funder.description: Funder or buyer; null where withheld.

source_url.description: The official listing; null where withheld.

apply_url.description: The application link; null where withheld.

access.description: Level of detail in this record.

tools.name: get_opportunity
tools.title: Get a funding opportunity
tools.description: Fetch one Raise Lens grant or tender by its raiselens.com URL or id. Returns its title, summary, sectors, geography, deadline, amount, a link to the opportunity page and, where the opportunity page shows them, the funder, description, eligibility and key requirements. Public notices are named in full at once; other listings 14 days after Raise Lens lists them, or at once with full access.

url_or_id.description: A raiselens.com opportunity URL, or the opportunity id.

amount_display.description: Funding amount as published, or null when none is given.

source_url.description: The original listing at the source.

date_added.description: When Raise Lens added the record.

access.description: Level of detail in this record.

cta.description: Link to the Raise Lens page that lists what each option includes.

tools.name: list_sectors
tools.title: List sectors
tools.description: List the sector slugs Raise Lens classifies opportunities against, each with a readable label. These slugs are the values the sector filters on this server accept.

tools.name: search_funders
tools.title: Search funders and investors
tools.description: Search the Raise Lens directory of sustainability funders and investors (foundations, climate VCs, corporate investors, development finance institutions, government funders) by topic, funder type, funding type and geography. Returns up to 20 funders ranked by relevance to the query, then by how many open opportunities each has on Raise Lens. Each has name, type, funding types, sectors, geographic focus, cheque size, next deadline, how to apply, open opportunity count and its raiselens.com page.

query.description: What the funder backs, e.g. "green hydrogen", "mangrove restoration", or a funder name.

funding_type.description: grant, equity, debt, guarantee or any. Matches what the funder states, or what its type implies when it states nothing.

geography.description: Country or region: ISO-2 ("KE"), English name ("Kenya") or a region ("East Africa"). Matches funders based there or naming it in their focus.

open_now.description: true: only funders open to applications or with open opportunities listed.

geographic_focus.description: Countries and regions the funder states it covers.

cheque_size.description: Usual and largest ticket, in words (USD).

open_to_applications.description: yes, no or unknown, as the funder states it.

application_note.description: How to approach or apply, as the funder describes it.

open_opportunity_count.description: Open grants and calls from this funder listed on Raise Lens.

access.description: Level of detail in this record: summary or full.

recent_grants.description: Recent grants or investments to organisations.

plans_url.description: Raise Lens page that lists what each option includes; null when every record is full.

tools.name: funder_rhythm
tools.title: Funder call rhythm
tools.description: When one funder's calls usually open and close, and the typical window from opening to deadline, from its past calls listed on Raise Lens. Shown only when there are at least 3 past calls with both dates; a pattern from past calls, not a forecast. Includes the decision time when the funder states one.

url_or_slug.description: A Raise Lens funder slug, or its raiselens.com/funders URL.

opening_pattern.description: usual (months that repeat) or spread (no month repeats).

decision_time.description: As the funder states it; never estimated.

rhythm.description: null with fewer than 3 past calls.

tools.name: list_recent_raises
tools.title: List recent funding rounds
tools.description: Climate and sustainability companies that closed a funding round in the last N days (up to 90), newest first. Each raise has company, amount, currency, amount_usd, round, round_date, detected_date, sectors, countries, investors, source_url (the primary source; null when only a feed is known) and raiselens_url. Also returns totals by sector, country and round. By default only checked company rounds: no funder pages or fund news, no off-sector rows, a source article that names the company, and a round date within 60 days. Each raise also carries hiring (open roles, roles in business development and partnerships, and the careers page) when the company has open roles on file. Optional filters: Raise Lens sector slug, country (ISO-2 or aggregate such as EU, AFRICA, GLOBAL), hiring_only.

sector.description: One Raise Lens sector slug, such as renewable-energy.

country.description: ISO-2 code or aggregate (EU, AFRICA, ASIA, LATAM, GLOBAL).

deals_only.description: false also returns funder-page context the classifier filed as investment (programmes, portfolio pages).

checked_only.description: false also returns deals that fail the checks (no article URL naming the company, off-sector, fund news, round older than 60 days).

date_basis.description: announced: round date when the source gives one; detected: when Raise Lens picked it up.

hiring_only.description: true returns only companies that raised and are now hiring (open roles on file).

source_url.description: The primary source; null when only a feed is known.

kind.description: deal, or context for funder-page items.

bd_roles.description: Open roles in business development, partnerships or fundraising.

careers_url.description: The employer's own careers page or job board.

hiring.description: Raised and now hiring: open roles read from the company's own job board; null when none are on file.

now_hiring.description: Raises whose company has open roles on file.
